scope: AI-assisted source-based qualitative review of diagnosis explanations, separate from patch-location proxy. Reviewers receive answers with condition names hidden; self-references in answers may reveal tools. No human-certified correctness claim and no project tests run.

labels.supported: Main explanation is supported by the pre-fix source and reported issue; no material contradiction identified. Minor omissions may remain.
labels.mixed: A useful part of the explanation is supported, but a material error or omission is identified.
labels.insufficient: The main explanation is missing, unsupported, or materially misdescribes the reported behavior.

rules: Evaluate all measured answers, including empty, unfinished and low-location-score answers.
Reference patch locations guide review but do not uniquely establish causality or make an alternative location incorrect.
Check actual code behavior, conditions/defaults and source responsibility; do not reward path overlap as explanation correctness.
Do not call a proposed fix validated; project code and tests were not executed.
Record uncertainty and concrete source evidence. Labels do not certify every detail or exact line reference.
